summary: TaxSimba Phase 1 full-stack test. Backend: 29/30 pytest cases pass — full end-to-end workflow on a freshly-created case (create → assign HIGH priority to Accountant A → start review → request-from-client (creates task + doc-request + client notification) → client uploads file (task auto-completes and case flips to ACCOUNTANT_REVIEW) → V1 → checklist-incomplete rejected → checklist-complete accepted → admin returns V1 → V1 locked → V2 created → resubmit → admin approves → client sees only approved V2 → client approves → READY_FOR_SUBMISSION visible identically to client/accountant/admin) all pass. Role isolation, activity timeline, stats endpoints, notifications, super-admin user create/toggle, workflow settings and audit log all pass. Frontend: login+redirect works for all 4 roles, admin dashboard shows all 8 stat cards and navigates to filtered case list with all 4 filters, accountant dashboard shows all 7 stat cards, super-admin at /super renders all 7 tabs and user-create form, client dashboard renders Journey + client-action-card, /my-return shows V2 figures (£50,000 / £36,000 / £7,200) with 'You approved version 2' banner and 'Ready for Submission' status, notifications-btn + notification-count visible, mobile-nav-toggle visible at 390px.

minor.issue: Does not check user.is_active. A super-admin-deactivated user can still successfully call /api/auth/login and receive a valid JWT (200). Subsequent /api/auth/me returns 401 because get_current_user does check is_active, so the token is effectively useless — but login itself should return 401. Add `if not user.get('is_active', True): raise HTTPException(401, 'Account disabled')` in the login handler.

action_items: Enforce is_active check in /api/auth/login so deactivated users get 401 at the login step (minor security/UX polish).
critical_code_review_comments: CORS is set with allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject credentialed requests to wildcard origin; front-end works only because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is same-site via ingress. For prod hardening, explicitly list origins from env var CORS_ORIGINS (already in .env) instead of '*'.
server.py is 858 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting cases/documents/super-admin routers into separate modules for maintainability.
Login cookie is set with samesite='none' + secure=True; that's correct for cross-site but means the httpOnly cookie will not be sent over plain http (fine in this prod-only preview).
seed.py should upsert admin password to match ADMIN_PASSWORD env var on every startup (playbook requirement — please verify).
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook expects lockout after 5 failed attempts).
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md as-is. All 6 seed accounts authenticate successfully.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates one fresh case via POST /api/cases for Client B and drives it through the full 20-step workflow. Also creates one TEST_ prefixed accountant via /api/users. Both left in DB (case is now READY_FOR_SUBMISSION for Client B under Accountant A).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_taxsimba_phase1.py drives a full clean workflow every run — safe to re-run. Frontend passes all data-testid selectors from the spec. Only outstanding gap is the login is_active check (minor). Super Admin route is /super (not /admin/super). Accountant tab id `acc-tab-due_this_week` is not currently rendered (only 5 of 6 tabs visible: needs_my_action, awaiting_client, ready_for_admin, admin_changes, completed) — could be a real gap or intentional; not blocking.
rca of the issue: auth/login bug: server.py login() only calls verify_password, never checks user['is_active']. Meanwhile get_current_user() DOES check is_active. Result: deactivated user gets a valid token from /login (200) but every subsequent /me returns 401. Fix in server.py login(): after password verify, add `if not user.get('is_active', True): raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail='Account disabled')`.
